summary: Completed comprehensive testing of PhoneSoftware module. All 22 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend testing verified: Admin/Worker login, role-based access restrictions, repair creation with manual customer data, QR code receipt modal, public repair status page, status updates, and print coupon functionality.

QR code generation working correctly with qrcode library
Public endpoints properly exclude sensitive data (customer_id, technician_id, etc.)
